name: WPCafe Elementor Addon – Restaurant Menu, Ordering and Reservation Widgets
author: Arraytics

sections.description:
WPCafe Elementor Addon extends the power of WPCafe by adding beautiful, drag-and-drop widgets for restaurant menus, online food ordering, table reservations and Restaurant Location.
Easily design and customize every section of your restaurant website visually inside Elementor, no coding required.

Whether you run a café, restaurant, bakery, or food delivery business, this addon helps you build elegant layouts and boost conversions with interactive restaurant sections.

Key Features

  • Elementor Integration: Convert all WPCafe shortcodes into drag-and-drop Elementor widgets
  • Easy Customization: Style your widgets directly within Elementor’s interface
  • Responsive Design: All widgets are fully responsive and mobile-friendly
  • No Coding Required: Build stunning restaurant and cafe pages without touching code
  • Real-time Preview: See your changes instantly with Elementor’s live preview
  • Professional Templates: Access to professionally designed widget templates

Widgets Included

  • Food Menu Display
  • Reservation Form
  • Restaurant Location
  • Food Categories
  • Menu Items Grid

Please check out our other awesome WordPress plugins:

📅 Eventin: All-in-one event management plugin for WordPress.

🍽️ WPCafe:Manage online Food Ordering, Restaurant Menu, Delivery, and Reservations.

📅 WP Timetics : AI-powered Appointment Scheduling plugin for WordPress

🎨 Poptics:Create Conversion-Driven Popups and convert your leads into sales.

🗓️ Booktics: The most powerful all-in-one free online booking plugin for service-based businesses.

Installation

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/cafetics directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Make sure WPCafe and Elementor plugins are installed and activated
  4. Start building your restaurant pages with Elementor!

Changelog

1.0.0

  • Initial release
